subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] mm/huge_memory: dequeue the deferred split after the split freeze

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped in the Linux kernel's huge_memory module. It removes a workaround that was necessary due to a previous fix for deferred_split_isolate, and instead unqueues the folio from the deferred split list after it has been frozen and its memory control group is still set. This change ensures that the folio is properly removed from the list even when the split is called from deferred_split_scan, which would otherwise leave the PG_partially_mapped flag set and prevent MTHP_STAT_NR_ANON_PARTIALLY_MAPPED from decreasing.

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David (Arm) suggested breaking out the sequence of operations involving __folio_unqueue_deferred_split() into a local helper function in mm/huge_memory.c, and proposed doing it as a separate cleanup.
